extension.description: Öffnet ein eigenes Prozessinformationen-Fenster. Dieses enthält Codec-, Video- und Audio-Details zum aktuell abgespielten Medium.
Opens a separate process information window. This window displays codec, video, and audio details for the currently playing media.
Megnyit egy külön saját lejátszófolyamat infó ablakot. Ez az ablak az éppen lejátszott média, kodek- videó- ​​hang- és egyéb adatait jeleníti meg.
extension.news: v1.4.5 - Added a "Bit depth" row to the VIDEO section showing the source bit depth (12-bit for Dolby Vision FEL, MediaInfo-measured for other formats). Requires tools.tinyppi 1.0.2+ for non-DV detection. v1.4.4 - Pulled in v1.5.6 improvements: source video bit-depth detection (dovi_tool RPU for Dolby Vision incl. FEL 12-bit, MediaInfo for other formats); refactored CoreELEC DV mode switching; new theme colours (HeaderIconColor, LineColor, DialogFocus colours). Header chart icon now uses HeaderIconColor. v1.4.3 - Header title set to uppercase white; removed the separator line under the header. v1.4.2 - Enlarged the Modern background to enclose the "Player Process Info" title and chart icon, with a subtle separator line below the header. v1.4.1 - Migrated the full Player Process Info panel into the Modern overlay (Display output, Pixel format, Color gamut, audio Bitrate, Subtitle language and all field rows). - Added a graceful fallback for devices that do not expose amlogic InfoLabels (e.g. the VTB decode path): unresolved labels no longer echo their own name and now fall back to generic display/colour InfoLabels. - Added "Player Process Info" header with chart icon; centred the right-side speaker/codec graphic. - Fixed the dangling " / N/A" in the Mode row when no Dolby Vision metadata is present. - Dolby Vision detection (CM version, L5/L6) now self-tests its ffmpeg/dovi_tool binaries once per session and logs the real reason when they cannot run. v1.3.6.8 - Wired the Theme color engine into the overlay skin: title, section icons, field labels, data values, filename, progress bars and the Modern background now follow the Theme settings. Default settings reproduce the original look; codec logo icons are unchanged. v1.3.6.7 - Added the Theme color engine: 12 customisable overlay colors (background, title, filename, header, icon, chart, description, output, FPS, progress, accent, unit) with 50 presets each plus custom HEX input and a reset action. Skin color wiring to be applied separately.
